definitions.explanation: A small social insect that lives in organized colonies. Known for their industriousness and teamwork.

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}が{砂糖|さとう}に{群|むら}がっている。
examples.english: Ants are swarming around the sugar.
examples.notes: {群|むら}がる = to swarm, to gather

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}は{自分|じぶん}の{体重|たいじゅう}の{何倍|なんばい}もの{重|おも}さを{運|はこ}べる。
examples.english: Ants can carry many times their own body weight.

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}の{行列|ぎょうれつ}が{地面|じめん}に{長|なが}く{続|つづ}いていた。
examples.english: A long line of ants stretched across the ground.

examples.japanese: {台所|だいどころ}に{蟻|あり}が{入|はい}ってきたので、{巣|す}を{探|さが}して{退治|たいじ}した。
examples.english: Ants got into the kitchen, so I found their nest and exterminated them.

examples.japanese: {蟻|あり}は{小|ちい}さい{体|からだ}なのに、{仲間|なかま}と{協力|きょうりょく}して{大|おお}きな{食|た}べ{物|もの}を{巣|す}まで{運|はこ}んでいく。
examples.english: Despite their small bodies, ants work together with their companions to carry large food back to the nest.

notes:
{蟻|あり} refers to ants in general.

Common expressions:
- {蟻|あり}の{行列|ぎょうれつ} (a line of ants)
- {蟻|あり}の{巣|す} (ant nest, anthill)
- {蟻|あり}{地獄|じごく} (antlion pit; also used figuratively for inescapable situations)
- {働|はたら}き{蟻|あり} (worker ant; also used for hard-working people)

Counter: {匹|ひき}

Related proverb:
{蟻|あり}の{一穴|いっけつ} - "one ant's hole" - meaning a small problem can lead to big disaster, similar to "a small leak will sink a great ship."
